goal.statement: A cashier completes a POS sale — from first item added to invoice issued — in under 10 seconds, with zero price discrepancies and no cross-store data leaks.
goal.metric: Time from cart creation to invoice issued < 10 seconds. Zero cashier sales recorded under wrong store. Zero orders with mismatched totalVnd.

actors.name: Cashier / Thu ngân
actors.goal: Process a customer's purchase quickly and correctly

impacts.action: Create an order for current store
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: No way to record a sale

impacts.action: Confirm payment and trigger invoice generation
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Sale not finalized, no invoice issued

impacts.action: Cancel a pending order if customer changes mind
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Ghost pending orders accumulate, reports are skewed

actors.name: Store Manager / Quản lý cửa hàng

impacts.action: View all store orders with filters
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: No daily sales overview, cannot spot fraud

impacts.action: Cancel an order in exceptional cases
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Manager cannot help cashier with problematic orders

actors.name: System (Invoice module)
actors.goal: Automatically issue a legal invoice upon payment confirmation

impacts.action: Listen for OrderCompletedEvent, generate invoice, mark order completed
impacts.hinders_if_not_done: Orders stuck in 'processing' indefinitely, no invoice

actors.name: Accountant / Kế toán
actors.goal: Reconcile daily sales for VAT reporting

impacts.action: View order history with date range and cashier filters
impacts.deliverable: GET /api/v1/orders (accountant scope = all store orders, read-only)

constraints: totalVnd must ALWAYS be calculated server-side — never trust client-supplied total
Price snapshot on OrderItem is the single source of truth for historical amounts
State transitions are one-directional — no rollback except via explicit cancel or refund
orderNumber must be gap-free per store per day — use DB sequence not application counter
